title: Personal Access Token
description: Authenticates gpm to the git repository over HTTPS. The token is stored; only a masked preview is shown here.
maskedHelp: Only the first and last characters are shown. Recreate the token on your git host if you need the full value.
verifyFailed: Couldn't authenticate with that token. Check it's valid and not expired, then try again.
clearConfirm: Remove the stored token? Syncing will need a new token or SSH key to push.
